title_en: Chinese History (2/20): Yu the Great Tames the Flood
note_en: The pattern 不是 A，而是 B means "not A, but B": it rejects one option and puts the one the speaker considers right after 而是. Look at Yu's method: 他不是一味地堵，而是顺着地势挖通河道 "he did not just keep blocking the water, but dug channels along the lay of the land." It is sharper than a plain 但是, and the text uses it again for contrasts like 强调的不是神的惩罚，而是人…战胜自然灾害.
